scripts.deploy: npm run validate && npx vitest run && npm run gates && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/backup-d1.mjs --reason pre-migration && wrangler d1 migrations apply hq --remote
scripts.demo: wrangler d1 migrations apply hq-demo --local --config wrangler.demo.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/demo && wrangler d1 execute hq-demo --local --config wrangler.demo.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/demo --file scripts/seed-demo.sql && X_LOCAL_OBSERVABILITY=false wrangler dev --local --config wrangler.demo.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/demo --env-file demo.vars --port 8790
